protocol: USAF chamber indoctrination. The source gives ten minutes of ground oxygen and twenty minutes of denitrogenation by ascent through 15,000 ft. The reported peak was held for about one minute.
outcome_window: Arm paresthesia and dry substernal sensation began after descent to 35,000 ft. Neurological deficits were recognized at ground level, with later circulatory collapse.
locator: Case Report and Altitude Chamber Flight pp. 1004–1006
note: Fourteen other trainees were on the selected flight. Their follow-up is unavailable. Goodman Case 8 gives two minutes at peak, while this original describes approximately one minute.
